boundaries.name: \Gamma_o
boundaries.description: outer circle / pipe casing, exchanges heat with warm environment through convection and surface radiation; fixed boundary

boundaries.name: \Gamma_i
boundaries.description: inner circle / tube wall swept by cooling water by convection; design boundary whose shape is optimised

constants.name: q_b
constants.description: casing temperature weight, q_b = h_C (u_amb - u_C) = 1000 * 15

constants.name: R
constants.description: outer radius of the pipe cross-section (fixed)

constants.name: r_0
constants.description: initial inner radius (inner boundary is a design boundary)

objective.name: J(u)
objective.description: Minimising J keeps the casing cold, i.e. maximises the heat absorbed from the environment through Gamma_o.

state_equation.description: Non-linear heat conduction in the annular domain with convection on the inner circle (cooling water) and convection plus surface radiation on the outer circle (environment).
state_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{D} k \chi (\nabla u \cdot \nabla \delta u)\,dx + \int_{\Gamma_i} h_C u \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} h u \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} \varepsilon \sigma u^{4} \delta u \,ds_x
state_equation.weak_form_rhs: \int_{\Gamma_i} h_C u_C \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} h u_{amb} \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} \varepsilon \sigma u_{amb}^{4} \delta u \,ds_x

newton_linearisation.description: Newton update [u_hat] solves the linearised state operator at state [u] with radiation term linearised as d_u[\varepsilon \sigma (u^4 - u_amb^4)] u_hat = 4 \varepsilon \sigma u^3 u_hat; state updated as u <- u - u_hat.

adjoint_equation.description: Adjoint state [u_tilde]; the adjoint operator equals the linearisation of the state operator at u (self-adjoint), with adjoint load from the partial derivative of the casing temperature integral in the objective.
adjoint_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{D} k \chi (\nabla \delta u \cdot \nabla \tilde u)\,dx + \int_{\Gamma_i} h_C \delta u \tilde u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} h \delta u \tilde u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} 4 \varepsilon \sigma u^{3} \delta u \tilde u \,ds_x

boundaries.name: \Gamma_o
boundaries.description: outer circle / pipe casing, exchanges heat with warm environment through convection and surface radiation; fixed boundary

boundaries.name: \Gamma_i
boundaries.description: inner circle / tube wall swept by cooling water by convection; design boundary whose shape is optimised

fields.name: u
fields.rationale: No Dirichlet boundaries; all boundaries are Robin, so dirichlet_value is null and dirichlet_labels is empty.

constants.name: q_b
constants.description: casing temperature weight, q_b = h_C (u_amb - u_C) = 1000 * 15

constants.name: R
constants.description: outer radius of the pipe cross-section (fixed)

constants.name: r_0
constants.description: initial inner radius (inner boundary is a design boundary)

optimization_config.rationale: Parameters chosen for level-set shape optimization of the inner cooling channel in an annular pipe wall. hmin/hmax resolve the inner boundary and outer casing; diffusion and v0 control regularization and step size; 30 iterations balance cost and convergence. Boundary labels: design=2 (inner Robin), fixed=3 (outer Robin).
